thread:
olivia_sre: Quick sanity check — we're switching ETL DB and the archived object buckets to customer-managed keys this afternoon. Planning RBAC tighten + kv-lock on backup access. Any known gotchas?

matt_infra: Do we have a validated grant workflow for the backup uploader service account?

sara_security: Not yet. Last audit showed the uploader used a long-lived grant. Need ephemeral grants with explicit IAM condition.

yash_eng: I'll run a dry-run decrypt test against last week's snapshot in staging. Can someone confirm the rotation window?

jess_oncall: Heads-up — oncall shift starts in 45m, tag me if you want immediate rollback support. :thumbsup:

olivia_sre: Good catch @jess_oncall. If decrypt fails in staging we stop rollout. Also want verbose audit logging on uploads.

encops-bot: Ticket #ENC-2147 created: "CMK switch for etl-db + buckets — grant hardening + audit logs" assigned to @matt_infra and @sara_security. ETA 4h.

matt_infra: For the uploader, propose this policy snippet: ```json { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234", "Condition": {"ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {"kms:GrantName": "upload-temp"}} } ```

yash_eng: That Condition won't work for older grants. We should create a short-lived grant via the API at start-of-job and revoke after upload. I can add that to uploader code.

sara_security: Also add audit manifest: uploader should write a tiny manifest file next to the object with SHA+key-id so we can cross-check decrypt attempts in CloudTrail.

olivia_sre: Manifest idea is great. Let's add a periodic canary restore job that decrypts a subset of backups using new CMK path.

jess_oncall: Agree, schedule canary during low traffic. I'll own runbook if anything fails.

matt_infra: If we flip CMK for DB snapshots, will the DB service still create snapshots during rotation window? Need to avoid implicit-deny when grants expire.

sara_security: We'll create transition grants: old-key -> dual-grant window for 30m so snapshots created around switch are covered. Monitor CloudWatch KMSErrorCount.

yash_eng: Kicking off staging decrypt now. Output: 
>> restore-test --snapshot=etl-stg-2026-03-20
Decrypt succeeded using key-id: abcd-1234
Manifest SHA matches: true

olivia_sre: Nice. Staging looks good. Next: RBAC audit to ensure no broad principals have kms:Decrypt on new CMK.

matt_infra: Found legacy role etl-legacy-runner with kms:* on account. Propose replace with scoped role and remove wildcard.

sara_security: Strong yes. I'll migrate: create new scoped role, update cron jobs, then remove wildcard.

encops-bot: Reminder: backup retention audit policy logs manifest mismatch as HIGH severity.

jess_oncall: If canary shows manifest mismatch, immediate rollback and open incident channel. I'll page infra and sec.

olivia_sre: Edge case: object lifecycle rehydration jobs read backups — ensure they call grant create API or they'll fail post-rollout. @yash_eng can you grep for kms:Decrypt usages?

yash_eng: Found two rehydration jobs under archiver/service — PR coming to add ephemeral grant flow.

matt_infra: Plan: create temp grant -> upload -> manifest -> archive -> restore canary -> revoke grant. If green, flip prod.

sara_security: Adding CloudTrail filter: eventName in [Encrypt, Decrypt, CreateGrant, RetireGrant] for CMK to dedicated S3 with 90d retention.

olivia_sre: Timeline: code PRs in 2h, staging canary in 3h, prod rollout in tonight's maintenance window.

jess_oncall: I'll be available for window and prepare pager rotation.

yash_eng: PR: https://git.company/archiver/merge/92 — includes grant create/revoke and manifest write.

matt_infra: I'll provision CMK alias alias/etl-cmk-prod and pre-create transition grants for window.

sara_security: Post-rollout checklist: RBAC diff, CloudTrail sample, canary logs, review failed decrypts.

olivia_sre: Thanks team. Proceeding with plan in 3h unless objections. :rocket:
